PROBLEM STATEMENT & PHILOSOPHY

Rethinking Personal Finance Management

Addressing Data Isolation, Demo Record Pollution, and AI Hallucinations

TENANT INTEGRITY
1. Multi-User Isolation
  • Industry Flaw: Most local finance trackers lack real user authentication or leak state across sessions using hardcoded demo IDs.
  • FinAI Engineering: Enforces strict multi-user relational architecture in SQLite with session-bound isolation.
  • Zero-Trust Backend: Every API query filters strictly by authenticated session['user_id'].
  • IDOR Prevention: Client-supplied IDs in payloads are rejected; data ownership is strictly verified.
CLEAN LEDGER
2. Zero-Demo Onboarding
  • Industry Flaw: Applications often seed dozens of fake records on registration, confusing users and distorting analytics.
  • FinAI Engineering: Dedicated clean database schema with zero demo pollution.
  • Pristine Starting Ledger: Newly registered users start with exactly ₹0.00 balance, 0 transactions, and 0 budgets.
  • Friendly Onboarding: Intelligent empty states guide the user to log their first genuine transaction.
FACTUAL AI
3. Grounded AI Advisory
  • Industry Flaw: Generic LLMs hallucinate financial balances, invent categories, and offer unverifiable advice.
  • FinAI Engineering: Dual-engine AI architecture combining Gemini 1.5 with deterministic local heuristics.
  • Transaction Grounding: Real user metrics are calculated dynamically and injected into system prompts.
  • Explicit Labeling: Clearly separates verified facts [ACTUAL DATA] from forecasts [PROJECTED ESTIMATE].

ENGINEERING CHOICES

Technology Stack & Architectural Roles

Modern, Lightweight, Production-Grade Technologies with Zero Unnecessary Bloat

UI & VISUALIZATION
Frontend: React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS
  • React 18: Component-driven architecture, custom AuthContext, instantaneous UI transitions.
  • Vite: Ultra-fast Hot Module Replacement (HMR) and optimized ES-module production builds.
  • Tailwind CSS: Strict monochrome palette (#000000, #FFFFFF, #E5E5E5) with zero runtime styling overhead.
  • Recharts: Vectorized SVG charting for cash flow bars, category donuts, and savings trajectories.
API & AUTHENTICATION
Backend: Python Flask & REST API
  • Flask Microframework: Explicit control over request lifecycle, session cookies, and route middleware.
  • Werkzeug Security: Enterprise-grade PBKDF2-SHA256 password hashing with unique salt generation.
  • Flask-CORS: Configured with supports_credentials=True for secure cross-origin session cookies.
  • Python Dotenv: Secure environment variable isolation protecting secret keys and credentials.
RELATIONAL PERSISTENCE
Database: SQLite Relational Schema
  • SQLite 3: Serverless, zero-maintenance ACID-compliant database with zero network daemon overhead.
  • Relational Constraints: Explicit foreign key enforcement (PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON) on all connections.
  • Indexed Queries: High-performance index lookups on user_id, dates, and categories.
  • Cascading Deletes: Clean, atomic cleanup of child records when account actions occur.
ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
AI Engine: Google Gemini 1.5 Flash
  • Gemini 1.5 Flash: Sub-second inference latency, broad context window, and exceptional reasoning capacity.
  • Prompt Grounding: Injects live mathematical aggregates into Gemini prompts, preventing hallucinated numbers.
  • Strict Verification Protocol: Enforces explicit tagging of verified facts vs forecast projections.
  • Local Heuristic Fallback: Regex and pattern-matching NLP engine guarantees uninterrupted service.

DATA ARCHITECTURE

Multi-User Database Schema & Isolation Model

Enforced Foreign Key Constraints, Tenant Isolation, and Zero-Demo Defaults

USER IDENTITY
Table: users
  • id: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY
  • full_name: TEXT NOT NULL
  • email: TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL
  • password_hash: TEXT (PBKDF2)
  • created_at, updated_at: TEXT
FINANCIAL LEDGER
Table: transactions
  • id: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY
  • user_id: INTEGER (FK -> users.id)
  • transaction_type: 'income'|'expense'
  • amount: REAL, category: TEXT
  • payment_method, transaction_date
SPENDING LIMITS
Table: budgets
  • id: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY
  • user_id: INTEGER (FK -> users.id)
  • category: TEXT NOT NULL
  • monthly_limit: REAL NOT NULL
  • month: INTEGER, year: INTEGER
SETTINGS & AUDIT LOGS
Tables: user_settings & ai_messages
  • user_settings: id, user_id (FK), currency ('₹'), preferences (JSON)
  • ai_messages: id, user_id (FK), role ('user'|'assistant'), message, timestamp
  • Every conversation thread is strictly partitioned per user ID.
SECURITY GUARANTEES
Enforced Multi-Tenant Isolation Rules
  • Zero-Trust Backend: API endpoints never trust a user ID supplied by request bodies or URL parameters.
  • Session Authority: User identity is extracted solely from the cryptographic server session.
  • Referential Integrity: PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON ensures orphan records cannot exist.
  • Pristine Start: Registrations create empty accounts starting with strictly ₹0.00 balance.

ENGINEERING DEEP DIVE

Technical Challenges & Engineering Solutions

Overcoming Practical Implementation Hurdles and Establishing Future Growth Vectors

TENANT SECURITY
1. Strict Multi-User Data Isolation
  • Challenge: Preventing data leakage across sessions and eliminating reliance on hardcoded mock IDs.
  • Engineering Fix: Enforced SQLite foreign key constraints (PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON).
  • Security Model: Server-side session authentication. Backend ignores client-supplied user IDs and enforces data ownership on all CRUD operations.
CRYPTOGRAPHY
2. Cryptographic Portability on macOS
  • Challenge: Standard scrypt hashing threw AttributeError on macOS Python 3.9 / LibreSSL runtimes.
  • Engineering Fix: Standardized password hashing on Werkzeug's pbkdf2:sha256 algorithm.
  • Result: 100% cross-platform compatibility across macOS, Linux, and Windows with cryptographically secure salts.
AI FACTUALITY
3. Eliminating AI Hallucinations
  • Challenge: Generic LLMs fabricate financial figures and offer inaccurate advice without transaction context.
  • Engineering Fix: Engineered a context-injection pipeline that computes actual totals before prompting Gemini.
  • Dual-Mode Engine: Seamless local rule-based heuristic parser ensures zero downtime when API quotas are hit.
FUTURE ROADMAP
4. Future Scope & Roadmap
  • Automated Bank Feeds: Integration with Open Banking / Plaid API for automated transaction sync.
  • Recurring Subscriptions: Automated detection and renewal alerts for monthly recurring bills.
  • Mobile Application: Native iOS and Android companion app developed with React Native.
  • Multi-Currency & FX: Real-time currency conversions for international transactions.
